rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0001, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-15 (one knob vs iter-14 best). NUMBERS soft_thresh at n_bands=24,n_outer=1: 0.0007->hr0.0299, 0.0003->0.0343(iter-14 BEST) -- lighter thresh keeps more true residual structure, monotone-improving hr. FAILURE MODE: at 24 bands step-1 is clean so the residual is mostly genuine aliasing structure, and thresholding it away costs RMSE. ONE KNOB: wu_soft_thresh 0.0003 -> 0.0001 (much lighter, near zero; n_bands locked 24). HYPOTHESIS: if the residual is genuinely clean at 24 bands, near-zero thresholding (add back essentially the whole single-pass residual) further lowers RMSE -> hr above 0.0343; if residual noise then dominates (hr down), the thresh optimum brackets in (0.0001,0.0003) and I bisect. Budget: ~seconds.
